purpose: Fixed-protocol, independent-seed replicate campaign answering reviewer comment 1 (manuscript_v2/revision.md section A): round-1 'replicates' varied cooling rate, chain length, chain count, annealing and pressure ladder, conflating stochastic uncertainty with protocol and finite-size effects. Here decided_params are frozen per system and ONLY the two seeds vary.

design.stereo_note: Each system carries ONE stereochemistry for all three of its replicates, so seed variance and stereo effect are never confounded. Stereochemistry is expressed only in the repeat-unit SMILES (@/@@) -- guides/polymer_rules.json:263: tacticity is not a parameter and is rejected as a run-plan override.

seed_knobs_note: This checkout has exactly TWO seed knobs (scientific_control.py OVERRIDE_RANGES). revision.md section A step 3 asks for 'EMC build seed + SEED_HOT/SEED_COLD'; SEED_HOT/SEED_COLD are derived from velocity_seed inside the deck generator (mcp-servers/mcp-lammps-engine/script_generator.py: SEED_HOT=vseed, SEED_COLD=vseed+1), so pinning velocity_seed pins both.
planning_path: make_deterministic_plan.py run-plan --polymer_class <CLASS> --with-ff-probe --baseline  ->  agent_api.py start --plan <scaffold> --dry-run. --baseline stamps confidence=low so the plan materializes with NO LLM in the loop: a fixed-protocol claim cannot rest on a critic pass that is not rerun for replicates 2 and 3.
polymer_class_is_passed_explicitly: run_graph.py classifies from the SMILES and is deliberately NOT used here: RadonPy's polyinfo_classifier returns PHAL for any 2-mer PVC dyad (measured 2026-09-08). guides/class_overrides.json is not the right home for that -- its own scope rule admits only molecules that appear in polymer_rules.json member_smiles -- so the class is stated per system instead.

iPMMA.stereo_expression: One defined backbone stereocentre in a 1-mer: every repeat is built with the same configuration, which is isotactic by construction. The @ vs @@ choice is inert here -- the two are enantiomeric chains and physically indistinguishable.

override_citations.experimental_tg_K: db/experimental_db.sqlite tg_measurements, form='isotactic' for poly(methyl methacrylate): 311.15, 318.0, 319.15, 323.15, 325.15 K (PolymerHandbook4ed / PolymerDataHandbook1999). Median 319 K. PACR's class default 378 K is the ATACTIC value and would score a correct isotactic run as a ~60 K failure. Corroborated by Macromolecules 2021 10.1021/acs.macromol.1c01341 (320 K) and Soldera 2005 10.1016/j.compositesa.2004.10.019 (~333 K).
override_citations.bm_pressures_atm: PACR declares no ladder; pinned to the shared glassy ladder so the Murnaghan series is defined and priceable rather than falling through to protocol_policy's conservative_unscreened default.
override_citations.T_equil_K: PROTOCOL, not grading. experimental_tg_K=319 (isotactic) is the value the Tg RESULT is graded against; it must not size the melt. Left to the derivation max(T_equil_K, Tg+200) it produced a 550 K melt hold -- 28 K below the 578 K the curated class Tg (378 K, atactic PMMA) would have given -- and iPMMA_1's melt came back kinetically trapped on 2026-09-09: chain COM displacement 0.493x Rg^2, g3(t) exponent 0.073 (r2 0.825), C(t) 3.8% decayed, against 2.79-4.85x for the other three systems. 600 K is PACR's own md_tg_ceiling_K -- the class bound on how hot its chemistry's MD Tg gets -- chosen over the 578 K class-derived value because PCFF PMMA is the slowest-relaxing chemistry in the set: of the four round-1 PMMA campaigns, two sat below 1.0x Rg^2 even at 578 K. annealing_T_high_K 700 records what the resolver commands (T_equil + 100), 100 K of margin above the melt, comparable to PLLA_1's 80 K. stage_params.temperature_schedule now floors the protocol term by the curated class Tg so a grading override can never cool a melt again; this pin sits ON TOP of that floor.

unpinned_and_why.experimental_density_gcm3: Class member value 1.19 resolves through the stereo-stripped SMILES match. Tacticity shifts PMMA density by well under 1%, so the atactic value stands.

aPS.stereo_expression: No stereo marker: EMC places each backbone centre without stereocontrol, which is the atactic build. This is the set's stereochemical control.

override_citations.bm_pressures_atm: PSTR declares no ladder; shared glassy ladder.

aPS.open_protocol_question: Round 1 found MELT_STAGE_DEFICIT on all four PS replicates -- melt density already 2.3-5.6% below the exp-extrapolated melt value, so slower re-cooling cannot fix it. Gated on the pilot: do not launch replicates 2 and 3 until replicate 1's melt density is assessed.

sPVC.class_divergence_reason: RadonPy's polyinfo_classifier returns PVNL for the 1-mer *CC(*)Cl (via guides/class_overrides.json) but PHAL for ANY 2-mer PVC dyad, stereo or not -- measured 2026-09-08 on *CC(Cl)CC(Cl)*, *C[C@@H](Cl)C[C@H](Cl)* and *C[C@@H](Cl)C[C@@H](Cl)*. It is a repeat-unit-cut artifact of matching on the extracted mainchain, not a stereo effect. PHAL routes to OPLS-AA; OPLS-AA is a recorded EMC build failure for PVC (polymer_rules.json PVNL ff_note), so PVNL/PCFF is the correct protocol.
sPVC.stereo_expression: Syndiotactic requires a period-2 repeat: a 1-mer can only build all-same (isotactic). The racemo dyad alternates configuration along the chain. Parity anchor: the isotactic dyad used by the i-PVC1 run (2026-08-15, measured m=0.988) is *C[C@H](Cl)C[C@H](Cl)*; @/@@ is the other stereo class and therefore syndiotactic. CIP labels are useless here -- RDKit reports (S),(S) for the syndiotactic dyad and (S),(R) for the isotactic one, because the two *-terminated arms carry different CIP priorities.
sPVC.dp_unit_rule: decided_params.dp_typical counts DYADS. dp_typical=41 is 82 vinyl chloride monomers per chain. Any consumer wanting a monomer count (the DP>=30 glassy carve-out in the equilibration gate, run-summary dp) needs 2x. Do not 'correct' 41 to 82 in the plan.

override_citations.experimental_tg_K: db/experimental_db.sqlite tg_measurements for poly(vinyl chloride), PolymerHandbook4ed: the 354.15 K row carries the note 'Increasing syndiotactic content increases Tg to 371K', and a separate DSC row (20 deg/min, Mn->infinity, onset, varied annealing) reads 371.15 K. PVNL's class default 354 K is the atactic/commercial value.
override_citations.T_workflow_K: REQUIRED, not cosmetic. The dyad matches no PVNL member_smiles, so resolve_member_value refuses, _regime_exp_tg falls through to the group-contribution estimate (196 K + 80 K uncertainty = 276 K), and workflow_reference_temperature collapses T_workflow_K from 530 to 300 -- which makes stage_params._regime call glassy PVC RUBBERY at final_T_K=300 and drops the deform fallback from the mechanical stage. Measured on the scaffold: sPVC came out at T_workflow_K=300.0 where every other glassy system is at its class T_equil_K. 530.0 is PVNL's own class value. materialize_plan only rewrites T_workflow_K when T_equil_K is overridden, so pinning experimental_tg_K alone leaves the stale 300 K in the file.
override_citations.experimental_density_gcm3: db/experimental_db.sqlite density_measurements, PolymerDataHandbook1999: 1.391 g/cm3 at 293.15 K, phase='amorphous'. CAVEAT, carried into the grading: the row's own note discloses 11.3% crystallinity (typical commercial PVC, Pham et al. Makromol Chem 175, 1974). It is therefore an UPPER BOUND for a fully amorphous cell, and is the weakest experimental target in this set. PVNL curates no experimental_density_gcm3 at all, so without this pin density has no comparator.
override_citations.bm_pressures_atm: PVNL declares no ladder; shared glassy ladder.

sPVC.capability_vs_accuracy: sPVC is primarily a CAPABILITY member. Fully syndiotactic PVC is crystalline experimentally, and the prior i-PVC1 run found iso-vs-atactic density and bulk modulus consistent with no effect. The deliverable here is that the requested stereochemistry is expressed and measurable in the built cell; the Tg comparison carries the crystallinity caveat above.

PLLA.stereo_expression: L-enantiopure. Verified by capping, not by reading @/@@: substituting the two * with their real continuation atoms gives O[C@@H](C)C(=O)O, which RDKit assigns CIP (S) and canonicalises to C[C@H](O)C(=O)O -- byte-identical to the L-(+)-lactic acid reference. The opposite parity gives (R) = D-lactic acid.

override_citations.experimental_density_gcm3: db/experimental_db.sqlite density_measurements, Garlotta2001 citing Mikos et al. (1994) Polymer 35(5):1068: amorphous PLLA 1.248 g/cm3, phase='amorphous', ~298 K. PEST curates no experimental_density_gcm3, so density had no comparator without this.
override_citations.experimental_tg_K: polymer_rules.json PEST.experimental_tg_K.PLA = 331 K, inside db/experimental_db.sqlite's own L-PLA range 326-337 K (PolymerHandbook4ed). Pinned rather than resolved because this cut does not match member_smiles.PLA, so resolve_member_value refuses.
override_citations.T_workflow_K: REQUIRED, same failure as sPVC. Without the member match, _regime_exp_tg falls to the group-contribution estimate (173 K + 80 K = 253 K), which is BELOW final_T_K=300 and flips PLLA from glassy to rubbery. 620.0 is PEST's own class T_equil_K.

PLLA.smiles_cut_note: NOT PEST's member_smiles.PLA cut. `*OC(C)C(*)=O` -- the curated member entry -- FAILS to build under PCFF/EMC: 'ScriptFieldEntryApply: Missing force field parameters' at dp=4, nchains=2 (measured 2026-09-08). The achiral form of that same cut fails identically, so it is a repeat-unit-cut problem, not a stereo one. This cut is the one round-1's PLA1..PLA4 actually built with (git show origin/main:manuscript/data/PLA1/raw/run_plan.json -> smiles '*C(C)C(=O)O*'), and it builds. polymer_rules.json PEST ff_note claims 'build-tested: PLA PASS' -- true of this cut, not of the member_smiles entry it sits next to.

unpinned_and_why.exp_K_GPa: PEST's [3.0, 4.5] carries an explicit unverified-provenance warning; indicative for PLLA, not binding.

PE.stereo_expression: Symmetric backbone, no stereocentre. The set's achiral aliphatic reference.

unpinned_and_why.everything: PHYC curates experimental_tg_K (195 K), experimental_density_gcm3 (0.855, fully amorphous TraPPE-UA comparator), exp_K_GPa (rubbery amorphous [1.5, 2.0]) and its own bm_pressures_atm ladder. Nothing needs pinning.
unpinned_and_why.bm_pressures_atm: PHYC's own [1, 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000, 15000] is kept. It contains no zero and would FAIL the override validator's four-unique-points-including-zero rule, so it must stay a class value and must not be re-pinned.

PE.regime_note: PE is the set's only rubbery-at-300 K member (Tg 195 K). Its bulk modulus and equilibration gating follow the rubbery branch.

override_citations.bm_pressures_atm: PKTN declares no ladder; shared glassy ladder.

PEEK.open_protocol_question: Round 1 found UNDER_ANNEALED_COOLING on all four PEEK replicates and raised eq_annealing_cycles 8->12; that change has never been validated by a completed run. Gated on the pilot. Also the set's wall-time risk: T_equil = 770 K.

unpinned_and_why.experimental_density_gcm3: PKTN carries a bare scalar 1.263, which _exp_density_point accepts outright.

override_citations.experimental_density_gcm3: db/experimental_db.sqlite density_equations, Mark2007 Table 7.2 glass branch for bisphenol-A polysulfone: rho(t_C) = 1.242 - 2.59e-4 * t, valid 30-186 C, evaluated at the run's own final_T_K = 300 K (26.85 C) -> 1.235 g/cm3. Independently corroborated by Zoller1978_PSU (1.234 measured at 27 C on Union Carbide P-1700) and PolymerDataHandbook1999 (1.24). PSFO curates no experimental_density_gcm3.
override_citations.bm_pressures_atm: PSFO declares no ladder; shared glassy ladder.

PSU.known_bias: Round 1 recorded a systematic PCFF bias on PSU: density -4%, Tg +8%. Expected, disclosed, not corrected for.
PSU.selection_note: PSU replaced BPA-PC in this set. PCBN declares preferred_builder='radonpy' with DREIDING and QM RESP charges; run_campaign.py:306-310 refuses any preferred_builder other than 'emc', and select_hardware cannot price the gaff family on this host, so BPA-PC is neither runnable nor priceable as the class table stands.

shared_glassy_ladder.why: One ladder across all six glassy systems removes a varying axis from the benchmark. It is PEST's own curated ladder; 5 unique points, contains zero, 3 positive, so it satisfies _validate_protocol_relationships. Spans 5000 atm on the compression side, which the PEST calibration note requires for stiff aromatic backbones. PHYC is excluded -- it keeps its own rubbery ladder.

known_limitations: sPVC's experimental density is a commercial value carrying 11.3% crystallinity and is an upper bound only.
PEST's exp_K_GPa band has unverified provenance and is indicative for PLLA, not binding.
PE, PEEK and PSU are semicrystalline or crystallisable in practice; all three are graded against amorphous-phase comparators and that choice is disclosed rather than hidden.

The built stereochemistry is not yet measured by any tool in this checkout (run_campaign.py:390 says so outright). Until a dyad m/r-fraction measurement exists, the stereo claim rests on the SMILES and on the i-PVC1 parity anchor, not on the built cell.

guides/polymer_rules.json PEST.member_smiles.PLA (*OC(C)C(*)=O) does not build under PCFF/EMC. Not fixed here -- this campaign routes around it by using the buildable cut -- but it should be corrected in the class table, since anything resolving PLA through member_smiles inherits it.

forcefield_resolution.mechanism: forcefield.select_by_moiety(smiles, class_prior) selects the build field. SMARTS from guides/ff_moiety_rules.json (3 rules, measured over 982 real EMC trial builds on RadonPy's PI1070) narrow the candidates; a real EMC trial build decides among them. No blocker -> the class ff_accuracy_prior stands. Blocker matched -> probe ranked candidates and take whichever field actually types the repeat unit, which can move the field off the prior. Nothing types it -> field=None, D-01 admissible: [], refuse. The class supplies a prior, not the answer (preferred_ff was demoted to ff_accuracy_prior 2026-09-03).
forcefield_resolution.what_happened_here: Measured 2026-09-08: all 7 SMILES cleared the screen with blockers: [] and unscreened: False, so each D-01.choice is its class prior and resolved_by reads polymer_rules.json:classes.<CLASS>.ff_accuracy_prior.
forcefield_resolution.claim_limit: The chemistry was screened and cleared for all seven. None exercises the branch where chemistry moves the field OFF the prior, or the refusal path. A set demonstrating FF override rather than FF confirmation would need a member tripping carbonyl_adjacent_N (PAMD, PIMD, PURT, PURA).
forcefield_resolution.unscreened_caveat: ff_moiety_rules.json's coverage_gap: the 3 rules match 266 of 347 measured failures (77%); a SMILES matching no rule is a screen passing, not a coverage measurement.

recovery_configuration.state: NO recovery agent wired. The pilots were launched as `agent_api.py resume <RUN>` with no --recovery-agent-command, so WorkflowEngine.recovery_agent is None.
recovery_configuration.consequence: Two tiers, only one live. Deterministic auto-remedies (_auto_remedy: registry-routed, per-route capped, revision validated against the same bounds an agent decision must pass) DO fire and land in remedy_history / recovery_log.jsonl. Agent escalation does not: workflow_engine.py:1092-1093 returns escalation_required with reason 'no_recovery_agent_configured' and the run halts.
recovery_configuration.why_this_may_be_correct: Any recovery, agent or deterministic, mutates effective_parameters for ONE run. If replicate 1 takes a remedy and replicates 2-3 run the frozen plan, the three stop being replicates -- the exact round-1 defect this campaign exists to fix. The right response to a pilot finding is to fold the remedy into the canonical plan, re-freeze, and launch all three replicates from the corrected version. That is what 'pilot, gate, then expand' means.
recovery_configuration.cost: This campaign exercises NONE of the recovery-agent architecture (structured issues only, capped at two calls). That benchmark axis needs its own demonstration and cannot be read off these runs.
recovery_configuration.if_a_pilot_halts: escalation_required with agent_escalations: [] leaves the full budget of two agent calls unspent, so resuming that run with --recovery-agent-command wired is legitimate and re-burns nothing.
recovery_configuration.watch: A NON-ZERO remedy_history on any pilot means its effective_parameters have diverged from the frozen canonical plan. Do not launch that system's replicates 2-3 until the remedy is folded back into the canonical plan and re-frozen.

planning_configuration.state: NO LLM in the planning loop. Plans were built with make_deterministic_plan.py run-plan --baseline, which stamps confidence='low' so materialize_plan proceeds without a critic pass.
planning_configuration.deviation: The approved plan said to run each system through run_graph's full classify->plan->critique->adjudicate path so the critic's verdict would be the llm_contribution datum. Changed during implementation because run_graph.py has no --polymer_class flag and would have classified the sPVC dyad as PHAL, silently routing PVC to OPLS-AA; a uniform planning path across all seven was preferred to a mixed one.
planning_configuration.consequence: Every D-01 evidence row is origin='autofill' (the deterministic tool transcribing polymer_rules.json's ff_note, DOIs and primary sources). Zero rows are origin='critic'. No literature_grounding.json or classification.json exists for any of the 21 runs. The llm_contribution benchmark axis is empty.
planning_configuration.audit_gap: plan_mode reads 'reasoned' while confidence reads 'low' -- the plans are labelled as though an agent reasoned over them when none did. Same audit-consistency gap revision.md flagged on PLA1 in round 1.
planning_configuration.remedy_available: A critic pass over the seven frozen canonical plans costs no GPU time and does not touch the running pilots, whose decided_params are already fixed.
